<a id="symbol-Duration"></a>
## `Duration` · immutable record · [source](durations.aug#L6)

Exact signed int64 milliseconds. This value has no calendar, clock or scheduling effects. It takes `milliseconds` as an integer, kept read-only.

<a id="symbol-parseDuration"></a>
## `parseDuration` · [source](durations.aug#L13)

Parse a seconds-only duration: optional minus, PT, 1 to 16 integer digits, optional 1 to 3 fractional digits, then S.
Leading zeroes are accepted; other units, plus signs, spaces and excess precision are rejected.

It takes `text` as a string. Failures can raise `ConversionError` (Invalid syntax or a millisecond value outside int64).

It checks that `text.byteLength` is at least `4` and `text.byteLength` is at most `24`. It raises a `ConversionError` at the first failed check. It sets `negative` to `text.startsWith` with `prefix` `"-"`. It sets `start` to `2`. [source](durations.aug#L14-L17)

If `negative` is true, it checks that `text.startsWith` with `prefix` `"-PT"` returns true. It raises a `ConversionError` at the first failed check. It sets `start` to `3`. [source](durations.aug#L18-L24)

Otherwise, it checks that `text.startsWith` with `prefix` `"PT"` returns true. It raises a `ConversionError` at the first failed check. After that conditional work, it checks that `text.endsWith` with `suffix` `"S"` returns true. It raises a `ConversionError` at the first failed check. [source](durations.aug#L23-L26)

It sets `body` to [`asciiSlice`](ascii.aug.md#symbol-asciiSlice) with `input` from the UTF-8 bytes of `text`, `start`, and `end` from `text.byteLength` minus `1`. It sets `parts` to `body.split` with `separator` `"."`. It checks that the number of elements in `parts` is at most `2`. It raises a `ConversionError` at the first failed check. [source](durations.aug#L27-L30)

It sets `whole` to the item at index `0` in `parts`. It checks that `whole.isDecimal` returns true and `whole.byteLength` is at most `16`. It raises a `ConversionError` at the first failed check. It sets `fraction` to `"000"`. [source](durations.aug#L31-L47)

If the number of elements in `parts` equals `2`, it sets `fraction` to the item at index `1` in `parts`. It checks that `fraction.isDecimal` returns true and `fraction.byteLength` is at most `3`. It raises a `ConversionError` at the first failed check. While `fraction.byteLength` is less than `3`, it builds `fraction` as the text `{fraction}0`. [source](durations.aug#L36-L41)

After that conditional work, it builds `digits` as the text `{whole}{fraction}`. If `negative` is true, it builds `digits` as the text `-{digits}`. It returns a [`Duration`](durations.aug.md#symbol-Duration) with `milliseconds` from `digits.parseInteger`. If this work raises `IndexError`, it raises a `ConversionError`. [source](durations.aug#L42-L47)

<details>
<summary>Checked interface</summary>

```text
parseDuration(string text) returns Duration unless ConversionError
```

It takes `text` as a string (At most 24 ASCII bytes, such as PT1.25S). Failures can raise `ConversionError` (Invalid syntax or a millisecond value outside int64).

</details>

<a id="symbol-formatDuration"></a>
## `formatDuration` · [source](durations.aug#L52)

Format exact milliseconds as optional minus and PTseconds.fffS, including three fractional digits.
Zero has no sign; the complete int64 range is representable without rounding.

It takes `value` as [`Duration`](durations.aug.md#symbol-Duration).

It sets `seconds` to `value.milliseconds` divided by `1000`. It sets `remainder` to `value.milliseconds` remainder after division by `1000`. If `seconds` is negative, it sets `seconds` to the negative of (`seconds`). If `remainder` is negative, it sets `remainder` to the negative of (`remainder`). [source](durations.aug#L53-L58)

It sets `fraction` to the text `{remainder}`. While `fraction.byteLength` is less than `3`, it builds `fraction` as the text `0{fraction}`. After the loop, it sets `result` to the text `PT{seconds}.{fraction}S`. It returns the text `-{result}` if `value.milliseconds` is negative, or `result` otherwise. [source](durations.aug#L59-L65)

<details>
<summary>Checked interface</summary>

```text
formatDuration(Duration value) returns string
```

It takes `value` as [`Duration`](durations.aug.md#symbol-Duration).

</details>

<a id="symbol-durationFromSeconds"></a>
## `durationFromSeconds` · [source](durations.aug#L70)

Convert whole seconds to exact milliseconds. It takes `seconds` as an integer. Failures can raise `ArithmeticError` (Multiplication by 1000 overflows int64). It returns a [`Duration`](durations.aug.md#symbol-Duration) with `milliseconds` from [`checkedMultiply`](.aug-spec/august/1.0.0/math/integers.aug.md#symbol-checkedMultiply) with `left` from `seconds` and `right` `1000`. [source](durations.aug#L71)

<details>
<summary>Checked interface</summary>

```text
durationFromSeconds(int seconds) returns Duration unless ArithmeticError
```

It takes `seconds` as an integer. Failures can raise `ArithmeticError` (Multiplication by 1000 overflows int64).

</details>

<a id="symbol-addDurations"></a>
## `addDurations` · [source](durations.aug#L76)

Add milliseconds without wrapping. It takes `left` and `right` as [`Duration`](durations.aug.md#symbol-Duration). Failures can raise `ArithmeticError` (The total cannot fit int64). It returns a [`Duration`](durations.aug.md#symbol-Duration) with `milliseconds` from [`checkedAdd`](.aug-spec/august/1.0.0/math/integers.aug.md#symbol-checkedAdd) with `left` from `left.milliseconds` and `right` from `right.milliseconds`. [source](durations.aug#L77)

<details>
<summary>Checked interface</summary>

```text
addDurations(Duration left, Duration right) returns Duration unless ArithmeticError
```

It takes `left` and `right` as [`Duration`](durations.aug.md#symbol-Duration). Failures can raise `ArithmeticError` (The total cannot fit int64).

</details>

<a id="symbol-compareDurations"></a>
## `compareDurations` · [source](durations.aug#L80)

Compare exact millisecond values; return -1, 0 or 1. It takes `left` and `right` as [`Duration`](durations.aug.md#symbol-Duration). If `left.milliseconds` is less than `right.milliseconds`, it returns `-1`. It returns `1` if `left.milliseconds` is greater than `right.milliseconds`, or `0` otherwise. [source](durations.aug#L81-L85)

<details>
<summary>Checked interface</summary>

```text
compareDurations(Duration left, Duration right) returns int
```

It takes `left` and `right` as [`Duration`](durations.aug.md#symbol-Duration).

</details>

## Dependencies

It uses [`checkedAdd`](.aug-spec/august/1.0.0/math/integers.aug.md#symbol-checkedAdd) and [`checkedMultiply`](.aug-spec/august/1.0.0/math/integers.aug.md#symbol-checkedMultiply) from `august.math`. It uses [`asciiSlice`](ascii.aug.md#symbol-asciiSlice) from `ascii`.

Built-in operations follow the [language reference](https://greenpandastudios.github.io/augscript/language-constructs).
